summary: Live credentials API passed create/list/get/delete using a fresh backend session minted from preserved Privy auth state. Metadata-only behavior held for list/get, delete behaved as a soft-delete tombstone, and direct decrypt was blocked with 403 on both a full-scope session token and a read-only access token.
contract_findings: Direct decrypt is disabled in the live service even though older docs still describe POST /api/v1/credentials/:id/decrypt returning plaintext.
Create returned created_at as an epoch-seconds string instead of the RFC3339 example shown in the REST docs.
Delete is soft-delete: GET after delete still returns 200 with is_deleted=true and status=deleted.
The earlier api-auth session token had been revoked by logout; this case had to mint a fresh backend session from preserved Privy auth evidence before running C07.
/api/v1/auth/access-token returns the issued token nested at data.access_token in the observed live response.
